name: spinner-facts
description: Replaces the spinner verb with a random line from a facts file, scrolling long ones like an LED ticker.

factsFile.title: Facts file
factsFile.description: Absolute or ~/ path to a text file with one fact per line (blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped). Empty: the facts.txt shipped with the plugin.

width.title: Ticker width
width.description: Columns the text may take before it scrolls. 0 fits it to the terminal.

speedMs.title: Scroll step (ms)
speedMs.description: Milliseconds per one-character step. The engine redraws at most ten times a second, so 100 is the floor.

rotateLoops.title: Change a scrolling fact after (passes)
rotateLoops.description: How many times a fact too long to fit goes round before the next one follows it in. 0 keeps one fact for the whole turn.

rotateSeconds.title: Change a short fact after (seconds)
rotateSeconds.description: How long a fact that fits stays before the next one replaces it. 0 keeps one fact for the whole turn.
